en.p: For a real number $a$ with $a>1$, let A and B be the points where the line $y=-x+4$ meets the two curves

respectively, and let C be the point where the curve $y=a^{x-1}$ meets the $y$-axis. When $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=2\sqrt{2}$, the area of triangle ABC is $S$. Find the value of $50\times S$. [4 points]
